_meta.purpose: Khajistan TV programming — show catalogue, weekly grid, dated month.
_meta.clock: One station clock: Pakistan Standard Time, UTC+5, no daylight saving. The stream runs continuously; a slot names the hour a show starts, and a set tuning in joins whatever is on wherever it has got to.

channels.name: Channel 1 · Bioscope
channels.line: Feature films: Pakistani and Pashto cinema, off tape, disc and print and from the archive's holdings.

channels.name: Channel 2 · Drama
channels.line: PTV drama, serials at nine every night, and The Break between programmes.

channels.name: Channel 3 · Lost Lollywood
channels.line: Lost Lollywood Soundtracks, whole films' music end to end. Sound with no picture.

channels.name: Channel 4 · Family Tapes
channels.line: Weddings from family collections: the baraat, mehndi, mayun, nikah and walima, and Band Baja, the wedding brass bands, at six.

channels.name: Channel 5 · Mehfil
channels.line: Qawwali, naat, nasheed, ghazal, mushaira, folk song and the mela, on tape and on record.

channels.name: Channel 6 · Filmfarsi
channels.line: Pre-revolution Filmfarsi features and their trailers.

channels.name: Channel 7 · Night Bazaar
channels.line: Khwajasira rites and functions, horror on record, stage comedy, and interviews with film people.

channels.name: Channel 8 · National Iranian Radio and Television
channels.line: NIRT before 1979: Rangarang, the Cafe Show, Farrokhzad's Mikhak-e Noghrei, Cheshmak and Studio 11.

channels.name: Channel 9 · Geet Mala
channels.line: Lollywood and Pashto film song as it was shot, with the scenes around it.

channels.name: Channel 10 · Pop
channels.line: Pop and dabke in Arabic, Urdu, Punjabi, Pashto and Saraiki, on video and off the cassette.

channels.name: Channel 11 · Antenna
channels.line: Television taped off the air: station openings, news, testcards and whole evenings, off satellite and off the aerial.

channels.name: Channel 12 · Raqs
channels.line: Mujra and stage dance, folk dance (attan, jhumar and the mela's dancing), and Iraqi kawleeya, the hair dance of the gypsy parties.

channels.name: Channel 13 · Khajistan Radio
channels.line: Omar Ali Khan's radio shows and the region's records: Mondo Bizarro at nine, Saturday Street before Christmas, Punjab Side, The Voice, Baghdad, Kabul & Herat.

channels.name: Channel 14 · Jordan Television
channels.line: The Jordanian state channel's own evenings, mostly from the 1990s.

channels.name: Channel 15 · Home Movies
channels.line: The family camcorder away from the wedding: birthdays, children growing up, school days, trips north and the village.

jihadi-jams.name: Jihadi Jams
jihadi-jams.line: Nasheeds, and a few talks. From the blog The Few, The Proud, The Mujahideen, nearly all Arabic: Gaza and Iraq, Eid and Ramadan. From toorabora.info, Al Haj Faqeer Mohammad Darwesh and Mohammad Amin Hedaree. A Pashto set off the Internet Archive.

mehfil-3.name: Mehfil on Record
mehfil-3.line: The evening concert with no picture. A sitting-room recording, a stage night.

jordan-television.name: Jordan Television
jordan-television.line: The Jordanian state channel's own evenings, mostly from the 1990s.

nirt-variety.name: NIRT Variety
nirt-variety.line: Iranian television variety of the 1970s: the Rangarang run, the Cafe Show, Farrokhzad, Studio 11, Cheshmak.

mehfil-on-tape.name: Mehfil on Tape
mehfil-on-tape.line: The evening concert as somebody's cassette caught it. A sitting-room mehfil, a stage night.

folk-tv.name: Folk
folk-tv.line: Folk singers of the Indus and the Pashto belt.

devotional-tv.name: Naat
devotional-tv.line: Naat, hamd, manqabat, majlis, bayan and dua, sung, recited and played.

qawwali.name: Qawwali
qawwali.line: Qawwali parties, on record and on tape.

ghazal.name: Ghazal
ghazal.line: The ghazal and the sung nazm, at a sitting and off the cassette.

mela-sport.name: Mela
mela-sport.line: Kabaddi, horse riding and neza bazi at the country fair.

essakhailvi.name: Attaullah Khan Essakhailvi
essakhailvi.line: Attaullah Khan Essakhailvi's dohre and mahiye, off the cassette volumes.

bandial.name: Muhammad Hussain Bandial
bandial.line: Muhammad Hussain Bandial's songs, off the numbered cassette volumes, with a stage show and a television programme.

beyond-the-rivers.name: Beyond the Five Rivers
beyond-the-rivers.line: Folk, naat and the evening concert from the Arab world, Egypt, Afghanistan and Iran.

home-movies.name: Home Movies
home-movies.line: Birthdays, children growing up, school days, trips north and the village, off the family camcorder.

iqbal-day-mushaira.name: Iqbal Day Mushaira
iqbal-day-mushaira.line: Poets reading to a hall, on the day Pakistan keeps for Muhammad Iqbal.
